title: Discovery Marathon 2026 Review: Cebu's SRP Waterfront 42K
seo_title: Discovery Marathon 2026 Review | Cebu Philippines Race
meta_description: The Discovery Marathon 2026: September 20 at City Di Mare, Cebu City. 42K, 21K, 12K, 6K from KNC at the South Road Properties — registration pending.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at City Di Mare in Cebu's South Road Properties, this KNC-organised marathon offers unusual distances including 12K and 6K options. Registration pending.
verdict: The Discovery Marathon is a Cebu road race with an unusual distance spread: full marathon (42K), half (21K), 12K, and 6K — none of the standard 10K/5K pairings. Organised by KNC at City Di Mare, a waterfront development in Cebu's South Road Properties (SRP), it offers a flat, modern course with sea views. September in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon — warm but manageable. Registration isn't open yet. For Cebu runners wanting a full marathon with distinctive distance options, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: SRP: Cebu's Waterfront Corridor
paragraphs: Cebu's South Road Properties is a modern waterfront development with wide roads and sea views — an excellent marathon venue. [1] City Di Mare provides a central, well-venued race hub. KNC (the organiser behind Dagan Cebu) brings local race-production experience.
